lines: Today was kinda... crazy with all the fighting, huh.
Though I feel like they were almost all battles we didn't need to fight...
After classes were over, we of course didn't really feel like doing any voluntary training and were getting ready to leave right away.
Yukikaze was waiting for me at the main gate.
I-I kinda got a bad feeling again.
Yukikaze, huh. Do you need something? Your face doesn't exactly say, "Let's hang out because we bonded in battle today."
Yeah, it's nothing so pleasant. Sorry about that.
These students said they want to talk to you, Fuma.
Yukikaze looked unusually apologetic as some new Taimanin recruits appeared from behind her.
And they all looked at me with hatred.
You don't have to tell me. They had an acquaintance killed or something in the recent Fuma rebellion, right?
So you're the head of the Fuma Clan?
This is all you Fumas' fault!
Wait, that's not true! Fuma-chan didn't have anything to do with the rebellion earlier!
It was Gaiza and his minions who started that stupid thing! Fuma-chan didn't do anything wrong!!
Th-That's right! You heard that from Asagi-sensei, didn't you? It was only a small part of the Fuma Clan that rebelled, not all of them!
We know that. But if you had been a good leader, none of that would have happened. Right!?
Well, when you put it that way, there's nothing I can say. I'm partly to blame for not being able to stop Gaiza.
Are you joking?! If you knew, then why...?!
I'm not joking or anything. That's why I'm...
Wait, wait, wait! Let's stop yelling at each other like that.
And Fuma, stop saying things that are gonna touch a nerve!
All around Yukikaze, sparks were leaping out with a crackle.
I had no choice but to keep quiet.
I didn't bring these girls here for you to argue with them.
Even they know that you're not personally responsible, Fuma.
Hearing Yukikaze's words, the group of female Taimanin hung their heads.
But even then, there's still the feeling that they can't forgive you.
Ah, not you personally, but more like the feeling of not being able to forgive the head of the Fuma Clan. You know what I mean, right?
Yukikaze asked, but didn't listen for my reply and just kept talking.
It's never good to keep those ugly feelings bottled up.
I brought them here with me so they'd be able to vent for a moment.
Yukikaze closed her mouth as if to say, "I guess you know what to do."
Hey, just in case, can I ask what I need to do for them to be able to let it go?
Eh? There's clearly no other way but to have a real fight, is there?
Ah, of course without anyone dying.
I got the answer I had expected and felt a wave of weariness.
You know I'm not strong. You just want me to get beat up.
That's not going to clear things up for either of you. You can fight together with those two as always.
Those two, who had been watching things play out, were taken aback, but Yukikaze continued on regardless.
Fuma, you need to get serious and take them on.
Wait, wait, waitーーーー! Why are you going to their side?! And I don't even have anything to do wi-... mghgmhmghm!
Shikanosuke was protesting with all his might, but Hebiko put her hand over his mouth.
Well, I guess we have no choice...
Otherwise, it didn't seem like the situation would be resolved.
Muhguguh, mhghguumghmgmーーーー!! (I don't wanna, I have nothing to do with itーーー!!)
That's the way it is. Yukikaze?
Yeah, we need to make sure that there's no trouble in the future.
I saw what you guys are capable of today, so I'm gonna kinda get serious♪
Yukikaze was happily sending flickering sparks out around her.
Hebiko, turn into an octopus. If you don't, you won't be able to deal with Yukikaze.
Guess there's no other way. Here goes!
With her mind made up, the lower half of Hebiko's body slid into its octopus form.
Why is this happening to meeeee?!!
Shikanosuke screamed, and Yukikaze and the girls leapt toward us.
(You shouldn't be the one to say that...!)
